content.text: Oscars 2026 Best Actor Predictions: Betting Odds RevealedThe 2026 Oscars are right around the corner!Right now, lots of people are debating which stars will take home some of the biggest prizes of the evening, including Best Actor.The official nominees won’t be announced until later this month, with the ceremony itself taking place on Sunday, March 15, 2026.Although there’s no official nominees list just yet, people are already placing their bets on prediction market Kalshi about who will most likely be nominated next year, pouring over $2 million into the market volume and counting.So what are the betting odds currently predicting?Click through to see the Top 10 predicted Best Actor nominees based on current market odds…...Den vollständigen Artikel findest du unter Just Jared4.1.2026von Just JaredJust JaredIMDb.com, Inc. übernimmt keine Verantwortung für den Inhalt oder die Richtigkeit der oben genannten Nachrichtenartikel, Tweets oder Blog-Beiträge.
